prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Pleasanton. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first a quick question so I give you the most useful picks:

1) Do you mean Pleasanton, CA? (There are a few Pleasantons in the U.S.)  
2) Do you want UV tanning (beds/booths) or a sunless spray tan (DHA or airbrush)? Or are you open to either?

If you want me to look up actual salons and phone numbers now, say “Yes — look them up” and confirm the city (and optionally your zip or how far you’re willing to drive). I’ll return a short list with contact info and reasons to call each.

Meanwhile, here’s a concise guide you can use right away — which specific types of salons to call and why, plus the exact questions to ask on the phone.

Which specific salons to call (by type) and why
- National chain (e.g., Palm Beach Tan, Planet Tan): consistent equipment, predictable pricing and membership deals, usually newer beds and standardized sanitation. Call them if you want reliability and memberships.
- Local boutique spray-tan studio: specialized in custom airbrush or booth spray tans, better color control and trained techs. Call if you want a natural-looking sunless tan or an event tan.
- Med-spa or esthetic clinic: offers professional sunless options, plus services like red-light therapy and skin consultations. Call if you’re concerned about skin sensitivity or want medically supervised options.
- Gym or tanning-only shops: often cheaper and convenient but variable cleanliness/equipment quality. Call to confirm maintenance and peak hours.
- Salon with both UV and spray options: good if you want to try both methods and speak to techs about safety and color matching.

Important questions to ask when you call
- Do you offer UV beds, stand-up booths, or spray tans (or a mix)? Which do you recommend for my skin type?  
- What types/brands of beds/lamps do you use and how old are they? (Newer lamps mean more even tanning.)  
- Do you offer a complimentary consultation for first-timers or a patch test for spray tans?  
- Are technicians licensed/trained in spray tanning? Do you use DHA solutions and can you customize color?  
- What safety/sanitation measures do you follow (linens, goggles, bed cleaning frequency)?  
- Age requirements and ID rules.  
- Pricing, packages, membership options, and how long a spray tan lasts there.  
- Cancellation/no-show policy for appointments.

Red flags on the phone
- Staff can’t describe equipment, solutions, or sanitation practices.  
- No patch test or consultation for first-time spray clients.  
- Extremely low prices with no clear explanation (may indicate poor upkeep).  

If you want, I’ll look up 4–6 highly rated Pleasanton-area salons (names, addresses, phone numbers), note whether they do UV vs spray, and give a one-line reason to call each. Tell me to proceed and confirm the Pleasanton (state) and your tanning preference.
